title: ECDL - Electrochemical Description Language
description: A standardized schema for encoding electrocatalyst durability test protocols, observations, and computed metrics. Developed by ElectrocatalystAI for protocol-aware durability benchmarking.

ReferenceElectrode.description: Reference electrode type for potential measurements

Regime.description: Electrochemical regime derived from pH or electrolyte

ExtractionMethod.description: Method used to extract this value from source

source_span.description: Original text span from which value was extracted

formula.description: Chemical formula if not a standard type (e.g., '0.5M H2SO4 + 0.1M HClO4')

high_V.description: Maximum potential applied during test (V vs reference)

low_V.description: Minimum potential applied during test (V vs reference)

scan_rate_mV_s.description: Potential scan rate for cyclic methods (mV/s)

regime.description: Derived from pH or electrolyte type

temperature_C.description: Test temperature in Celsius. null = unknown, NOT 25

duration_hours.description: Test duration in hours. NOT used in hazard calculation.

cycle_count.description: Number of cycles for cyclic tests. NOT used in hazard calculation.

working_electrode_substrate.description: Working electrode substrate material (e.g., 'GC', 'Ti', 'Au', 'carbon paper', 'Ti felt', 'FTO')

counter_electrode.description: Counter electrode material (e.g., 'Pt wire', 'Pt mesh', 'graphite rod', 'carbon cloth')

gas_saturation.description: Whether electrolyte was saturated/purged with gas

purge_duration_min.description: Duration of gas purge in minutes

electrolyte_flow_rate_mL_min.description: Electrolyte flow rate for flow cells (mL/min)

ast_protocol_name.description: Standard AST protocol name (e.g., 'DOE 2020', 'EU FCH JU', 'JRC', 'custom')

cell_type.description: Specific cell type (e.g., 'H-cell', 'single cell', 'differential cell', 'GDE half-cell')

catalyst_coated_membrane.description: Whether CCM (catalyst coated membrane) or GDE configuration

hot_pressing_conditions.description: MEA hot pressing conditions (temp, pressure, time)

water_resistivity_MOhm_cm.description: Ultrapure water resistivity (MΩ·cm), typically 18.2 for Milli-Q

conditioning_cycles.description: Number of conditioning CV cycles before measurement

reference_electrode_potential_vs_rhe_mV.description: Measured reference electrode potential vs RHE (mV)

stirring_rate_rpm.description: Magnetic stirring rate (rpm) for non-RDE cells

electrode_polishing_protocol.description: Electrode polishing protocol (e.g., '0.05 µm alumina, sonicate 5 min')

cv_for_ecsa_scan_rate_mV_s.description: CV scan rate for ECSA measurement (mV/s)

cv_for_ecsa_potential_range_V.description: CV potential range for ECSA measurement

hfr_measurement_frequency_kHz.description: Frequency for HFR measurement (kHz), typically 1-10 kHz

online_icp_ms_used.description: Whether online/in-situ ICP-MS was used for dissolution monitoring

online_gc_used.description: Whether online gas chromatography was used

online_ms_used.description: Whether online mass spectrometry (DEMS/OLEMS) was used

reference_electrode_verification.description: How reference electrode was verified (e.g., 'vs fresh RHE')

formula_raw.description: Original formula as reported in paper

support_loading_wt_percent.description: Metal loading on support (wt%), e.g., 20 for 20% Ir/C

oxygen_vacancy_concentration.description: Oxygen vacancy concentration if quantified (e.g., from XPS)

batch_lot_number.description: Batch or lot number for traceability

xrd_crystallite_size_nm.description: Crystallite size from XRD Scherrer analysis (nm)

lattice_strain_percent.description: Lattice strain from XRD (%), positive = tensile

xps_binding_energy_eV.description: XPS binding energies for key peaks (eV)

raman_d_band_cm.description: Raman D-band position (cm⁻¹) for carbon-based materials

raman_g_band_cm.description: Raman G-band position (cm⁻¹) for carbon-based materials

raman_metal_oxide_peaks.description: Characteristic Raman peaks for metal oxide (cm⁻¹)

pore_size_distribution_method.description: Method used for pore size distribution

zeta_potential_ph.description: pH at which zeta potential was measured

threshold_percent.description: Threshold used for tau calculation (e.g., 20 for tau20)

retention_percent.description: Final retention percentage at end of test

overpotential_reference_current_mA_cm2.description: Current density at which overpotential was measured

metal_loading_loss_percent.description: Percentage of metal loading lost to dissolution

energy_efficiency_percent.description: Energy efficiency for full cell tests (%)

cell_voltage_initial_V.description: Initial cell voltage for full cell (V)

cell_voltage_final_V.description: Final cell voltage for full cell (V)

particle_growth_factor.description: Ratio of final to initial particle size

s_number_definition.description: Definition of S-number used (mol O2 / mol metal dissolved)

stability_number_Sn.description: Stability number (mol product / mol catalyst dissolved) - different from S-number

asf_definition.description: Definition of ASF used (varies by author)

charge_transfer_resistance_initial_mOhm_.description: Initial charge transfer resistance from EIS (mΩ·cm²)

charge_transfer_resistance_final_mOhm_cm.description: Final charge transfer resistance from EIS (mΩ·cm²)

mass_transport_resistance_initial_mOhm_c.description: Initial mass transport resistance from EIS (mΩ·cm²)

mass_transport_resistance_final_mOhm_cm2.description: Final mass transport resistance from EIS (mΩ·cm²)

polarization_curve_available.description: Whether full polarization curve data is available

eis_nyquist_available.description: Whether Nyquist plot data is available

eis_bode_available.description: Whether Bode plot data is available

cv_redox_peaks_shifted.description: Whether CV redox peaks shifted position

product_gas_purity_percent.description: Product gas purity (e.g., O2 or H2) (%)

n_replicates.description: Number of replicate measurements for this observation

extrapolated.description: Whether value was extrapolated (vs directly measured)

severity_index.description: Calibrated severity index (DIMENSIONLESS, corpus-specific). Use this value.

uncertainty_was_capped.description: True if uncertainty was capped at 20× to prevent signal drowning

potential_was_soft_capped.description: True if potential hazard hit the tanh soft cap

physics_completeness.description: Fraction of physics fields present: [pH, T, E_high, j, format]. Excludes duration/cycles.

reporting_completeness.description: Full completeness including exposure and loading fields

retention_penalty_applied.description: True if penalized for >98% retention (minimal degradation)

was_clipped.description: True if normalization ratio was clipped to bounds

from_supplementary.description: Whether data came from supplementary information

supplementary_file.description: Name of supplementary file if applicable

raw_data_repository.description: Repository where raw data is deposited (e.g., 'Zenodo', 'Figshare')

conflicts_with.description: List of ECDL IDs this record conflicts with

supersedes.description: ECDL ID of record this supersedes (for corrections)

license.description: License for the source data (e.g., 'CC BY 4.0')

preprint.description: Whether source is a preprint (not peer-reviewed)

published_version_doi.description: DOI of published version (if preprint later published)

retracted.description: Whether the paper has been retracted

errata_affects_data.description: Whether errata affects the extracted data

expression_of_concern.description: Whether expression of concern has been issued

methods_supplementary_page.description: Page in supplementary where methods are detailed
